student_learning_goal: I can determine whether multiplication and division expressions are equivalent.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can determine whether multiplication and division expressions are equivalent.
header.character_watermark: Eddy in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.student_instructions: Test 8 pairs of mult/div expressions. Decide EQUIVALENT or NOT.
parts.visual_layout: Top of page. Eight pair rows.

parts.answer_key: EQ, NOT, EQ, EQ, EQ, EQ, EQ, EQ.

parts.student_instructions: Find an equivalent expression using a DIFFERENT operation.
parts.visual_layout: Middle of page. Four partner rows.

image_placeholders.description: Four rows in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2.5in. Pre-filled: '5x6 = ___÷ ___', '24÷4 = ___ x ___', '8x4 = ___ ÷ ___', '100÷10 = ___ x ___'. Header 'Cross-Operation Partner:'.
